fact: UNHCR states in October 2024 that Guinea's 2018 asylum law provides access to biometric refugee identity cards and travel documents but no implementing decree has been adopted, and that Guinea hosted 2,244 refugees and 57 asylum-seekers as of 30 August 2024.
title: GUINEA: Submission by the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees for the Universal Periodic Review, Fourth Cycle, 49th Session
